Approval of Fifteen-Year Renewal Option for the Cooperative Agreement with United
  Methodist Ministries–Los Angeles District at 115 Paseo de la Plaza
summary: Approves a fifteen-year renewal option for the cooperative agreement with United Methodist Ministries–Los Angeles District for the site at 115 Paseo de la Plaza in El Pueblo.
